scope.zh: 全项目持续研究范围；特定任务按自己的授权完成标准推进。
scope.en: Continuing project research scope; individual tasks retain their authorized completion standards.

objective.zh: 在同一展开中说明组织、意义、调节、学习、选择器修订、关切与智慧。
objective.en: Explain organization, significance, regulation, learning, selector revision, concern and wisdom within one unfolding.

premises.zh: 一元关系方法；明示局部模型给定输入，不把普遍有利方向放进定义。
premises.en: Monist relational method; expose supplied local inputs without defining universal favorable direction into the target.

completion.zh: 有条件候选与普遍、无假设及唯一必要性各有范围；沿当前生成根据所列条件判断。
completion.en: Conditional completion, universality, assumption-free grounding and exclusive necessity retain distinct scopes, assessed against the governing grounding criteria.
